fi-bodianus-rufus.title: Spanish Hogfish
fi-bodianus-rufus.summary: A Caribbean hogfish that will pick parasites off tankmates; best for large fish-only tanks.
rows: About 10 in (LiveAquaria max size); wild record 40 cm (15.7 in) TL (FishBase)
No. A reef becomes its buffet; keep it fish-only
Carnivore. Adults eat snails, worms, shrimp, mussels and small fish; feed meaty foods
Western Atlantic: Bermuda, southern Florida (USA) and throughout the Gulf of Mexico and Caribbean Sea to southern Brazil
notes: Needs a large fish-only tank (about 150 gal or more).

fi-bodianus-bimaculatus.title: Two-Spot (Candy) Hogfish
fi-bodianus-bimaculatus.summary: A small hogfish that fits tanks as small as about 30 gal.
rows: About 4 in (LiveAquaria max size); wild record 5.9 cm (2.3 in) SL (standard length) (FishBase)
With caution. A grown fish may eat small ornamental shrimp added after it
Carnivore. Enriched brine or mysis shrimp, other meaty foods and marine flake
Indo-Pacific: Madagascar to New Caledonia, Japan to New Zealand
